name.value: Middle Beach Lodge At The Headland

description.value: Middle Beach Lodge sits on 40 acres of secluded West Coast oceanfront near Tofino, featuring two lodges, twenty rustic self-contained cabins, and newer treehouse accommodations perched above the rainforest. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, rocky headlands, hand-cut forest walking trails, and an on-site lounge serving lunch and dinner. Ocean kayaking excursions are offered, making it a scenic base for exploring the Pacific Rim coast.

address.value: 400 MacKenzie Beach Road, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0
